# `cms_part_b_drug_use_information`

**Medicare Part B drug use information**

Literal HCPCS-level brand/generic display names and clinical drug-use summaries from the CMS Part B supporting workbook, at one row per HCPCS code per benefit year.

**Coverage.** Sampled by design; source coverage is not measured by this schema. Each generation maps one explicitly selected benefit year's CMS Part B supporting Drug Use Information worksheet linked to the pinned Part B spending release. Literal CMS name markers (* for multiple names) and Drug uses not available entries remain verbatim; CMS's clinical disclaimer notes are retained in source_selection_json. Actual qualification is recorded by the selected generation and retained source evidence. *(measured 2026-11-27)*

- **Parquet file:** `cms_part_b_drug_use_information.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `drug_use_id` | `VARCHAR` | Deterministic sha256 digest of the workbook SHA-256, benefit year, source sheet, and 1-based source row number. |
| `program` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Medicare Part B label; not interchangeable with Part D or Medicaid populations. |
| `benefit_year` | `INTEGER` | Explicit selected benefit year matching the linked cms_part_b_drug_spending release. |
| `hcpcs_code` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Medicare Billing Code (HCPCS Code), unique per benefit year and 1:1 with cms_part_b_drug_spending.hcpcs_code. |
| `drug_description` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Drug Description cell from the Drug Use Information worksheet. |
| `brand_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Brand Name cell from Drug Use Information, preserving CMS star markers and original spacing verbatim. |
| `generic_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Generic Name cell from Drug Use Information, preserving CMS star markers and empty strings where CMS reports no generic name. |
| `drug_uses` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Drug Uses*** text from CMS, including Drug uses not available entries preserved unchanged; not medical advice. |
| `drug_use_status` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit status (summary_provided, not_available, or empty) classifying drug_uses without altering the literal publisher text. |
| `value_states_json` | `VARCHAR` | Per-column cell state (value, empty, null, or absent) distinguishing blank CMS cells from missing cells. |
| `source_sheet` | `VARCHAR` | Exact worksheet name (Drug Use Information) in the retained CMS supporting workbook. |
| `source_row_number` | `INTEGER` | Exact 1-based worksheet row number in Drug Use Information. |
| `source_workbook_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Exact sha256 digest of the retained original CMS Excel workbook bytes. |
| `source_workbook_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official CMS download URL for the supporting workbook from dataset-resources. |
| `source_resources_url` | `VARCHAR` | Exact CMS dataset-resources endpoint matching cms_part_b_drug_spending.source_resources_url. |
| `source_release_logical_id` | `VARCHAR` | Logical identity of the pinned CMS Part B spending source release. |
| `source_release_digest` | `VARCHAR` | Artifact digest of the pinned CMS Part B spending source release. |
| `source_selection_json` | `VARCHAR` | Exact selected release identity, resources manifest digest, workbook resource metadata, headers, and CMS drug-use disclaimer and footnote legends. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Exact workbook URL, workbook SHA-256, resources URL/digest, sheet name, 1-based row number, cell coordinates, and observation timestamp. |
| `raw_row_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete literal worksheet row keyed by exact column header strings. |
